★Request
Show Satono Diamond
Assumes Trainer is off-screen

She was fast ever since she was little, but lately her bursts of speed have gotten even sharper!
I'm totally rooting for her with all my heart!

Truly the culmination of pure talent and elite training. Of course, the weaknesses born from that elite upbringing
peeped through here and there... but even those felt like room for immense growth.

――Just after the New Year. At the trainer meeting held in the gymnasium,
my colleagues were unusually buzzing with excitement.

(Hold back a bit longer. Not yet――
I want to go, I want to go... but I must stay calm and watch how things unfold...)

What do you mean 'what'? All those prospective trainers who came to scout Dia-chan!
Ahhh... she totally stole the whole spotlight. I don't know whether to feel jealous or thrilled~!

Yup! Whenever I run, I always give it everything I've got!
Especially when I'm up against Dia-chan!

(Still... I bet Dia-chan's gonna catch up to me.
After all, she's always snapped right at my heels!)

Fufu, I'd like to say 'please go easy on me'...
But Kita-chan, you've never gone easy on me in a race, have you?

(Let's see... this person is the last one...
Which means...)
Huh...? Trainer?
Huh? Whaaaaaaaat?!

(In the end, that person didn't come to see me.
The one who looked like they had something to tell me... Why...)

At last... "that girl" is finally running in a mock race.
Boy, this is gonna cause quite a stir right at the start of the year!

(Besides, this pack around me... Ugh, are they intentionally closing in on me?!
Khhh, I can't break out to the right or the left... But...!)

Listening to her best friend Kitasan's enthusiastic praise, I gazed at Satono Diamond
in the distance. A golden egg of the highest caliber. Infinite potential. And yet...

All right, that's enough! That's all for now, trainers.
Regarding the position of Satono Diamond's dedicated trainer...

Today's star is none other than the heiress of the Satono Group, "Satono Diamond."
And her primary rival is her dependable, spirited best friend, "Kitasan Black."

The Satono Group will be holding trainer trials after the Debut Race.
Any interested parties are requested to participate there.

She truly is a diamond-class prodigy...!
I would love, absolutely love to sign a contract with her...!
Yaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!

――!! Their momentum faltered!
Now――!!

Prospective trainers...! I see!
To think so many distinguished people have been watching me.
(Already this much of a gap?! That's Kita-chan for you...)

(All right, final turn...! Did I push a little too hard out in front?
Well, I set my own pace all the way here, so no matter how good Dia-chan is...)

Wh-What could this crowd of people be...?
...Kita-chan?

Ehehe! There's no way I could miss out
on Dia-chan's showcase race!
As someone who's already debuted, I'm gonna give you everything I've got!

(They're not... coming over here? But they looked so much like
they wanted to say something to me. And they had such a rare aura...)

――I am deeply honored, {0}.
I must brace myself and devote even greater effort to improving.

Haaaaaaah! All right, the runaway lead is a success!
I'm gonna push all the way to the finish line just like this!

She overtook Kitasan Black... by a nose?!
Before even making her debut? She truly is unbelievable!

I-I see... Dia-chan's family is holding an audition
to choose her trainer. Trainer, you're going to apply too, right?

Oh? That person in the stands getting along so well
with Kita-chan... who might that be...?

(I have prepared for so long. So many instructors, so much practice,
so much research, so many――expectations!)

That's right, tomorrow "that young lady" is finally participating in a mock race.
Just who will become her trainer...?

Just how extraordinary is Satono Diamond's talent?
At last, the curtains rose on the race.

Father, Mother, Dia promises you.
I will fulfill the dream of the Satono family, without fail!
(WOOOOOOOOOOHHH!!)

――A flower on a high peak. The daughter of an ultra-wealthy family. A presence
that an ordinary trainer shouldn't approach on mere passion alone.

Her running was magnificent. Accurately reading the critical moment of the race,
and timing her natural explosive acceleration to perfection...

I gave it some thought... but in the end, I decided not to apply.
――Because it felt far too out of my league.

Next up is Entry No. 28.
The final applicant, {0}.

I look forward to working with you all today. And also...
Thank you, Kita-chan. I'm so glad you came♪

Ah, you're a trainer too, aren't you? You seemed to be watching
really intently! Wasn't Dia-chan just incredible?
